tool.name: Mddb
tool.description: : This class is a wrapper for downloading a trajectory / topology pair from the MDDB Database.

param.name: outname_output_top_path
param.label: output PDB name
param.help: Path to the output toplogy file Format: [output].pdb

param.name: outname_output_trj_path
param.label: output MDCRD,TRR,XTC name
param.help: Path to the output trajectory file Format: [output].[format]

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: trj_format
param.label: trj_format
param.option: trr - Trajectory of a simulation experiment used by GROMACS
xtc - Portable binary format for trajectories produced by GROMACS package

param.name: frames
param.label: frames
param.help: Specify a frame range for the returned trajectory. Ranges are defined by dashes, and multiple ranges can be defined separated by commas. It can also be defined as the start:end:step format (ie: '10:20:2').

param.name: selection
param.label: selection
param.help: Specify a NGL-formatted selection for the returned trajectory. See here for the kind of selection that can be used: http://nglviewer.org/ngl/api/manual/usage/selection-language.html.

param.name: extra_files
param.label: extra_files
param.help: List of extra files to download. It should be a tuple with the name of the file and the path to be saved. (Json)
